item.description:
Journey 0.2.15

  • Merge passcodes into the 0.2.15 release
  • Reach pinned sites from a Snow Leopard Dock on the window's edge (#46)
  • Merge polish: closed windows, tab audio, Reader cleanup, PDF Save As (#45)
  • Top Sites: Edit mode's badges sit apart where tiles stand close
  • Reader: no giant blank icons, no repeated byline, no site name in the title
  • Tabs: a speaker on a tab playing sound, which mutes it
  • Windows: ⇧⌘T reopens a closed window; Move Tab to New Window, Merge All Windows
  • Polish: dimmed glyphs, PDF Save As, download folder, dark placeholders

Journey 0.2.14

  • Passwords from Passcodes: fill, codes, generator and saves through its browser bridge
  • Merge darkening: a site's own dark mode comes first (#44)

Journey 0.2.13

  • Darkening: a site's own dark mode comes first, and 439 pages read right
  • Merge darkening: website darkening, lines stay lines and real pages read right (#43)

Journey 0.2.12

  • Darkening: lines stay lines, and real pages read right
  • Merge polish: Top Sites thumbnails fly out of the wall; the tab overview opens under the fingers (#42)
  • Merge polish: edge-to-edge Metal Top Sites, Exposé-style tab overview, reliable ⌃Tab (#41)
  • Merge polish: real-article Reader, SF Symbols, clean bookmark names, link cleaning part 2, ad-blocker notices, tab overview, ⌃Tab, curved Top Sites (#40)
  • Merge polish: toolbar polish, sharper favicons, link cleaning everywhere, no One Tap (#33)
  • Merge polish: darkened websites are dark from the first paint (#20)
  • Merge polish: pages start loading before they're asked for (#14)
  • Merge polish: the page reflows smoothly as the sidebar slides (#13)

Journey 0.2.11

  • Tab overview and ⌃Tab: the tabs used last land sharp
  • Top Sites: whole from its first frame, and steady while it's showing
  • Tab overview: opens under the fingers, and moves more smoothly
  • Top Sites: a chosen thumbnail flies out of the wall into the page

Journey 0.2.10

  • Tab overview: pages as Exposé shows windows; a new tab is pictured as Top Sites
  • Top Sites: edge to edge, drawn with Metal
  • ⌃Tab: the window's key, every time, even with a page that keeps its keys

Journey 0.2.9

  • Top Sites: one curved wall, reflected in the floor, as in Safari 4
  • ⌃Tab: switch tabs in recently used order, with a ⌘Tab-style switcher
  • Tab overview: every tab at once, laid out as Exposé lays out windows
  • Ad blocking: hide "disable your ad blocker" notices, and what they leave behind
  • Link cleaning, part 2: share, referral and (if asked) affiliate parameters
  • Bookmarks: suggest a clean name, the site's on a homepage, the headline on an article
  • Chrome: SF Symbols for the toolbar, fields, bars and tab strip
  • Reader: offer it only for real articles, not stores, searches or homepages

Journey 0.2.8

  • Status bar: a bolt shield, not sparkles, marks a cleaned link
  • Ad blocking: hide Google's One Tap "Sign in with Google" prompt
  • Link cleaning everywhere: in pages, copies, in-page addresses and what's saved
  • Top Sites: the site's icon beside its name
  • Favicons: look harder, store sharper, and fetch on demand
  • Toolbar buttons light up under the pointer
  • Toolbar: + opens a new tab; Add Bookmark gets a bookmark ribbon
  • Sidebar: Bookmarks | Reading List as one segmented capsule

Journey 0.2.6

  • Performance notes: the pointer rests a tenth of a second before a preload
  • Preloading: typing keeps its preload when the pointer moves on; hovers wait 0.1 s
  • Preload a web address pasted into the address field
  • Performance notes: menu highlights preload too
  • Preload a History or Bookmarks menu item while it's highlighted in a new tab
  • Preloading: start 30 ms after typing settles, not 100
  • Preloading: catch up on the page the preload ended on
  • Performance notes: starting early, launch rule lookups, what didn't help
  • Preloading: off while web extensions are on; untaken preloads expire
  • Preload a bookmark on the bar while the pointer rests on it in a new tab
  • Start loading an unloaded tab when the pointer rests on it
  • Content blockers: look up every cached rule list at once at launch
  • Preload a Top Site while the pointer rests on its thumbnail
  • Preload typed addresses over a page too, to warm up the tab's load
  • Preload the Top Hit while an address is typed in a new tab

Journey 0.2.5

  • Sidebar: no dark strip at the page's edge as it widens
  • Sidebar: the page reflows as the sidebar slides
  • Sidebar: the page keeps its width while it slides

Journey 0.2.4

  • Merge polish: leave the App Sandbox, sidebar slides, address-field clicks (#12)
  • Address field: a click selects the whole address and keeps it selected
  • Toolbar: the Sidebar button comes first, left of back/forward, as in Safari
  • Sidebar slides open and closed

Journey 0.2.3

  • Leave the App Sandbox, so apps downloaded with Journey can be opened

Journey 0.2.2

  • Merge polish: releases, performance, and issues #2–#10 (#11)
  • Sidebar for bookmarks and the Reading List
  • A restored window shows its page's address, with the page focused
  • Websites' appearance, and dark mode for websites that have none
  • Pinned tabs
  • Merge polish: Safari 4/5 behaviours, privacy features and era details (#1)

Journey 0.2.1

  • Fix updates failing to install: expand the bundle ID in signed entitlements
  • Downloads button in the toolbar; new downloads fly into it
  • Reader slides up over a darker page, and back down to close
  • Remove an unused test page (YouTube refuses embeds on local pages)
  • Block YouTube's ads
  • Close the empty space hidden ads leave behind
  • Edit › Copy Clean Link (⇧⌘C): the page's address without tracking parameters
  • A click into the address field selects the whole address
  • History and Top Sites keep a site's title and picture over its error pages
  • Reader leaves out charts drawn from positioned boxes
  • Downloads: a quick download's size no longer shows as "Zero KB"
  • Activity: Snow Leopard's solid disclosure triangles instead of today's chevrons
  • Settings › Advanced › Check for updates automatically
  • Window titles for Top Sites, Bookmarks and History; no blank thumbnails
  • Docs: launch is ~200 ms to the window's first frame
  • Launch timeline: a mark for the first window's first frame
  • docs/performance.md: hover preconnect measured, no gain in WebKit
  • Filter list conversion 4x faster: byte searches, not String's
  • perf.sh --new-tabs; first-paint cost of element hiding documented
  • Bookmarks › Add Bookmarks for These Tabs…: the window's pages as a folder in the Bar
  • File › Open File…, Save As… and Page Setup…; Edit's text submenus
  • Rule lists: network rules first, lists converted at once, halves versioned apart
  • Picture in Picture: a video put back in its page keeps playing
  • Element hiding on every site, now that it costs nothing measurable
  • Element hiding: matched once per page, and generic rules only in the page

Journey 0.2.0

  • publish.sh: seed an empty releases repo; keep undo until the release exists
  • publish.sh: tolerate a release with no new commits
  • publish.sh: undo the version bump when a step fails before publishing
  • release.sh: notarize with the asc API key directly
  • scripts/publish.sh: one command to ship a self-updating release
  • perf.sh --settle: end on a blank page before measuring memory
  • perf.sh: break down Journey's own memory by category
  • Pages load ~30% faster: element hiding for the sites you visit, not every site
  • Faster launch and new tabs: lazy restored-tab configurations, thumbnails decoded off the main thread
  • Performance harness; cheaper language detection; Spotlight only when bookmarks change
  • Smoother automatic Picture in Picture
  • Picture in Picture, and automatic Picture in Picture when switching away
  • Web notifications; Sparkle for updates; smoke test signed like the shipped app
  • Release builds: Developer ID signing and notarization that works end to end
  • File > Import From Browser...: Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Arc and Safari
  • Translate pages on this Mac (Apple's Translation framework)
  • Settings > Websites: Safari's Auto-Play choice
  • AutoFill: Contacts card and credit cards (Settings > AutoFill)
  • Interaction tests for mouse drags and menus; fix tab tear-off and duplicate extensions
  • Journey Dev identity, Release smoke test, and one install script
  • Settings > General: Safari 5's "Default web browser" pop-up
  • Fix the Release build: tabList was inside the Debug-only helpers
  • Activity window (Window > Activity, Option-Command-A)
  • Top Sites: Edit mode, pinning, removing, and three sizes
  • SnapBack
  • release.sh --development: sign with Apple Development, skip notarization
  • Reader fonts and themes
  • Safari 4/5-style error page
  • Drop links on the tab strip; drag the site icon out of the address field
  • History grouped by day; Cover Flow shows drawn cards again
  • Extension context-menu items and keyboard commands
  • Strong password suggestions, CSV password import, and a password list
  • Settings > Websites: per-site zoom, camera/microphone and content-blocker choices
  • Find bar shows the match count ("3 of 130 matches")
  • Search suggestions and engine switching in the search field
  • EasyList and EasyPrivacy blocking, with element hiding
  • Unload idle background tabs and relieve memory pressure
  • Downloads that persist, resume and drag out
  • Bookmark folders, Bookmarks Bar overflow, drag reorder and link drops
  • Tab overflow menu and tab context menu
  • HTTP logins, certificate exceptions, and Safari 5's lock
  • Release pipeline: Developer ID signing, notarization, DMG
  • Develop menu (Settings › Advanced › Show Develop menu)
  • Cover Flow: adopt iTracks Classic's Metal renderer
  • Cover Flow in the Library (Safari 4)
  • Measure launch time and memory; README features and numbers
  • Reading List and VoiceOver support for the tab strip
  • Per-site zoom memory and camera/microphone prompts
  • Safari 4/5 status bar (⌘/)
  • Profiles: separate cookies and website data per window
  • Drag tabs out of a window, or into another one
  • Bookmarks library, Bookmarks menu, import/export, Spotlight
  • Era-styled alert sheets and a Journey app icon
  • Password AutoFill backed by the macOS Keychain
  • Drag tabs to reorder them
  • Private Browsing windows (⇧⌘N)
  • Milestone 4: site icons, Share, Mail, Handoff, Dock menu, Services, AppleScript
  • Era-styled Settings and Downloads, with Aqua controls
  • Safari Web Extensions via WKWebExtensionController
  • Reader (Safari 5 style) built on Mozilla Readability
  • Native traffic lights and corners; era-styled dark mode
  • Replace modern controls with custom Snow Leopard–era chrome
  • Content blocking, link tracking protection, isolated test profile (WIP)
  • Fix Settings crash; make snapshot harness reliable
  • Milestone 2: history, autocomplete, Top Sites, session restore, Downloads, Settings
  • Milestone 1: WebKit browser foundation with Safari 5 interface
  • Initial commit
